description: Camden Council Solar Energy Generation is a dataset listed in Camden open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Camden Council. This dashboard provides data on the solar energy generated across Camden Council key assets. Explore how much energy has been produced by renewable solar photovoltaic (PV) systems and how this is reducing operational Greenhouse Gas Emissions. Coverage: Camden, New South Wales. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are solar energy, renewables, sustainability, energy. The portal shows 363,835 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-camden-nsw-gov-au-portal.
